goal: descriptively settle H10A six-feature M6 on all seven KRA bet types using existing official final dividends
evidence_scope: already-observed fresh64 optional continuation; posthoc/descriptive only; not pristine confirmation
model_scope: H10A M6 six-feature conditional-logit probabilities; no refit and no core H10A artifact alteration in this phase

column_mapping.model_probability: exact byte-loaded numeric values from H10A fresh64_runner_probabilities.csv:m6_probability
column_mapping.ord: exact one-to-one join from the existing fresh64 runner outcome file on race_id+entry_id+chulNo
column_mapping.win: copied from H10A and verified exactly equal to the outcome source and to (ord == 1)

ticket_policy: one unit per race and bet type on the ticket maximizing model event probability minus closing-win-q proxy event probability
market_comparator: highest closing-win-q-derived event probability; direct closing-win q only for win and a proxy for the other six bet types
fee_treatment: official final KRA dividend used as gross return; do not deduct 20%/27% again because the final dividend already reflects takeout
forbidden_interpretations: identified real EV or Kelly sizing
